You can change Android display density and font scale from a computer using ADB.

Initial setup
1. Settings → About phone → tap Build number 7 times
2. Open Developer options
3. Turn on USB debugging
4. Connect to the computer and approve the debugging prompt
5. Run adb devices and verify the device is listed as device

Wireless ADB (Android 11+)
1. Developer options → Wireless debugging
2. Open “Pair device with pairing code”
3. On the computer: adb pair IP:pairing-port
4. Enter the 6-digit code
5. If needed: adb connect IP:connection-port

Check current values
Display density: adb shell wm density
Font scale: adb shell settings get system font_scale

Examples
Display density: adb shell wm density 360
Font 85%%: adb shell settings put system font_scale 0.85
Font 100%%: adb shell settings put system font_scale 1.0

Restore defaults
Display density: adb shell wm density reset
Font: adb shell settings put system font_scale 1.0

Record the current wm density value before changing it because an appropriate density varies by device.
